from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A person or entity involved in the legal case."""
    name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the person or entity")
    role: Optional[str] = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., Appellant, Respondent, Plaintiff, Defendant)")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """A specific court fee mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Amount in numeric form")
    borne_by: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who bears the fee (name or role)")
    fee_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., Appeal Fee, Case Handling Fee)")

class CaseIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """A case number or official document reference."""
    number: Optional[str] = Field(description="The case number string")
    level: Optional[str] = Field(description="Court level if identifiable (e.g., Intermediate, Supreme)")

class MonetaryDetail(BaseModel):
    """Specific monetary amounts involved in the dispute or execution."""
    amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Numeric amount")
    description: Optional[str] = Field(description="What the amount is for (e.g., Damages, Execution Sum)")
    action: Optional[str] = Field(description="Action taken (e.g., deducted, paid, forfeited)")

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single legal document."""
    case_numbers: List[CaseIdentifier] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of case numbers found")
    court_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the court issuing the document")
    case_category: Optional[str] = Field(description="Category of case (Civil, Criminal, Administrative, Execution)")
    parties: List[Party] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of parties and their roles")
    main_ruling_text: Optional[str] = Field(description="Core disposition text (e.g., 'Dismiss appeal, uphold original judgment')")
    fees: List[Fee] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Court fees associated with the document")
    amounts: List[MonetaryDetail] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Specific monetary amounts involved")
    outcome_status: Optional[str] = Field(description="Outcome status (Final, Retracted, Withdrawn, Retrial)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentInfo] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of parsed documents from the collection")
